name: EvoRAG General Knowledge & Technical Benchmark
description: Standard golden QA set evaluating factual precision, synthesis, and hybrid retrieval across technical documents.

ground_truth_contexts: Retrieval-Augmented Generation blends neural generation with dense/sparse document retrieval to eliminate hallucinations.
pairs.ground_truth_answer: Retrieval-Augmented Generation blends neural generation with dense or sparse document retrieval to ground LLM responses in external knowledge and reduce hallucinations.

pairs.query: How does evolutionary optimization improve RAG pipelines?
ground_truth_contexts: Evolutionary algorithms optimize hyperparameter combinations such as chunk size, overlap, top-k, and hybrid alpha by treating a RAG pipeline configuration as a chromosome.
pairs.ground_truth_answer: Evolutionary algorithms optimize hyperparameter combinations like chunk size, overlap, top-k, and hybrid alpha by treating configurations as chromosomes and evaluating them against fitness benchmarks.

pairs.query: Why is Reciprocal Rank Fusion useful in hybrid search?
ground_truth_contexts: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) normalizes disparate score distributions between vector and lexical retrievers.
pairs.ground_truth_answer: RRF normalizes disparate score distributions between vector and lexical retrievers, enabling smooth ranking combination.

pairs.query: What problem do dense vectors face with out-of-vocabulary terms?
ground_truth_contexts: Dense vectors struggle with rare product SKUs, exact hashes, and brand identifiers. BM25 easily indexes and ranks these tokens.
pairs.ground_truth_answer: Dense vectors struggle with rare product SKUs, exact hashes, and brand identifiers, whereas BM25 easily indexes and ranks exact tokens.

pairs.query: What optimal alpha coefficient yields peak MRR in production benchmarks?
ground_truth_contexts: In production benchmarks, an alpha between 0.6 and 0.7 yields peak Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
pairs.ground_truth_answer: An alpha coefficient between 0.6 and 0.7 yields peak Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) in production benchmarks.
